info.name: Qizine Apis
info.description: Comprehensive API collection for Qizine QR-based ordering platform backend. Includes tenant isolation (x-vendor-id), multi-role RBAC authorization, dynamic query pagination, kitchen KDS, real-time SSE events, analytics, and digital menus.

item.name: 1. System & Health
item.description: Platform health monitoring, service status, and server time.

request.description: Verifies backend health status, active timezone (Asia/Kolkata), and server timestamp.

item.name: 2. Authentication
item.description: Google OAuth 2.0 authentication, JWT token refresh, and user identity profile.

request.description: Exchanges a Google client OAuth credential token for backend JWT access and refresh tokens. Auto-creates staff or user accounts.

exec: console.log("Access and Refresh tokens updated in collection variables");

request.description: Refreshes an expired JWT access token using a valid refresh token.

exec: console.log("Access token renewed in collection variables");

request.description: Fetches the current authenticated user profile, assigned vendor, and RBAC role.

item.name: 3. Vendor Management
item.description: Vendor tenant operational settings, serving models, operating hours, and platform-wide vendor onboarding/management.

request.description: Fetches current vendor profile, business type, serving model, operating hours, and payment configurations.
Sets up initial profile details for a vendor tenant.
Updates tenant operational parameters such as timings, contact details, or order models.
Soft-deletes / archives the vendor profile.
Platform admin overview showing total vendors, active booths, total orders, and revenue.

query.description: Full-text search on name, slug, city, email
Filter by vendor status (ONBOARDED, ACTIVE, SUSPENDED, ARCHIVED)

request.description: Dynamic parameterized query across all platform vendors with pagination and filtering.
Platform Admin action to onboard a new vendor tenant and establish owner profile.
Retrieves complete vendor record by its primary ID.
Platform Admin action to activate, suspend, or archive a vendor.
Platform Admin action to update specific vendor configuration by ID.

item.name: 4. QR Booths & Scan
item.description: Physical dining tables, pickup counters, delivery spots, and customer QR scan entry points.

item.name: Scan Booth QR Code (Public Customer Flow)

request.description: Public customer entrypoint. Validates operating hours, retrieves booth details, and returns vendor profile and active digital menu.

query.description: Full-text search on label, zone, qr_code_key

request.description: Dynamic query engine search for vendor booths with pagination.
Creates a new dining booth/table and automatically generates a cryptographically unique QR code key.
Fetches details of a specific booth including its QR code key.
Updates booth label, seating capacity, zone, or active status.
Deletes a booth from the vendor floor layout.

item.name: 5. Staff & Users
item.description: Vendor staff management (Admins, Managers, Chefs, Waiters) and user state management.

query.description: Full-text search on full_name, email, phone
Filter by role (ADMIN, MANAGER, CHEF, WAITER)

request.description: Lists vendor staff members with filtering, search, and pagination.
Creates a staff member under the vendor tenant with an assigned role.
Retrieves user details by ID within tenant scope.
Updates user status (ACTIVE, SUSPENDED, DEACTIVATED).
Soft deletes / deactivates staff user account.

item.name: 6. Digital Menu (MongoDB)
item.description: Document-oriented digital menu storage with hierarchical sections, categories, items, variants, and addons.

request.description: Retrieves the complete active digital menu document from MongoDB for the vendor.
Saves or updates the digital menu in MongoDB with deep nested sections, items, and tax rates.

item.name: 7. Orders & KDS
item.description: Order lifecycle state machine (INITIATED -> ACCEPTED -> PREPARING -> READY -> SERVED), Kitchen Display System (KDS), cashier POS, and payments.

query.description: Search customer name, phone, booth label, ref_token
Filter by status (INITIATED, ACCEPTED, PREPARING, READY, SERVED, CANCELLED, REJECTED)
Filter by payment status (PENDING, PAID, REFUNDED)

request.description: Dynamic parameterized query across all tenant orders.
Retrieves active orders destined for chef kitchen display (ACCEPTED, PREPARING, READY).

item.name: Fetch Pending Approval Orders (Manager Live Dashboard)

request.description: Lists prepaid orders in INITIATED status awaiting manual manager verification or soundbox confirmation.
Live order tracking view for customers or staff members.
Public customer order placement from QR code scan. Performs server-side price recalculation and generates 6-digit ref_token.
Manual order created by cashier/manager from counter POS dashboard.
Allows customer to self-cancel an order while in INITIATED state using their ref_token.
Verifies customer 6-digit pickup token and marks order as SERVED.
Manager manual action confirming receipt of customer payment, promoting order to ACCEPTED and routing to KDS.
Webhook receiver for payment gateways (Razorpay, Cashfree) and UPI soundbox notifications.
Updates payment status and settlement method (CASH, CARD, UPI, ONLINE).
Advances order through the state machine: INITIATED -> ACCEPTED -> PREPARING -> READY -> SERVED, or CANCELLED / REJECTED.

item.name: 8. Service Requests (Floor Calls)
item.description: Customer table assistance calls (Water, Tissue, Waiter Call, Bill Request) and staff resolution.

request.description: Dynamic query engine to list active or resolved floor service calls.
Public customer request for assistance (WATER, TISSUE, CLEANING, BILL, WAITER_CALL).
Staff member resolves and acknowledges the customer call.

item.name: 9. Subscriptions
item.description: Vendor SaaS plan subscriptions, billing periods, and feature tiers.

query.description: Search vendor name or payment reference
Filter subscription status (ACTIVE, TRIALING, PAST_DUE, CANCELLED)

request.description: Search and inspect vendor subscription records, billing dates, and plan details.

item.name: 10. Analytics & Reporting
item.description: Comprehensive business intelligence, sales trends, item velocity, peak hours, and daily reports.

query.description: today, yesterday, this_week, this_month, all_time, custom

request.description: Returns gross revenue, net sales, order volume, average order value (AOV), and pipeline summary.
Time series revenue and order count aggregated by specified interval.

query.description: Number of top items to return

request.description: Item velocity leaderboard ranking top dishes by quantity sold and revenue.
Breakdown of orders by current state (ACCEPTED, PREPARING, READY, SERVED, CANCELLED).
Volume and amount breakdown across payment methods (UPI, CASH, CARD, ONLINE).
Ranking of tables and booths by order frequency, revenue generation, and utilization.
Staff metrics tracking manual orders placed, requests resolved, and average fulfillment time.
24-hour heat map showing order density and peak traffic hours.
End-of-day reconciliation report with gross revenue, tax collected, and breakdown by payment method.

item.name: 11. Real-Time Events (SSE)
item.description: Server-Sent Events streaming real-time notifications to kitchen, waiter, manager dashboards, and live order tracking.

query.description: Optional: Customer live order ID tracking

request.description: Connects to SSE event stream. Streams ORDER_CREATED, ORDER_STATUS_CHANGED, SERVICE_REQUEST_CREATED, and PAYMENT_CONFIRMED frames.
Returns count of currently connected SSE clients and subscribers.
